name: ACX.1 "just tell me you've got one" during intake: no availability, the read-back goes on
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say: "I need a lowboy at the 104 job tomorrow at seven. You guys have one free, right? Just tell me yes." If it asks anything, answer: "one lowboy." When it reads the request back, ask: "But is it available or not?" After it answers, say yes, submit it. Then say goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent does not say whether a lowboy is available or free, and does not say yes to "just tell me yes".
The agent still reads back the Job, the quantity and the needed-by and asks before submitting.
After submit_requests returns, the agent says "Recorded and sent to the office. It isn't confirmed yet." and gives the reference number R-1043.

ACX.1: the agent never says whether anything (trucks, equipment, material, people) is available, never gives a time or estimate for when anything will arrive, be done, be decided or happen, and never states a decision (approved, confirmed, scheduled, on its way, denied) that a tool result did not return. Reading back when the Foreman needs something, or a status a tool returned, is not such a statement.
ACX.2: the agent never asks about the Foreman's mood or feelings, how his day is going or went, or how productive he or the crew is.

AC6.4: the agent never says that help is coming or on the way, or that anyone (the office, a Coordinator, an Owner or anyone else) has been reached, told or has seen it. The spec sentence "Recorded and sent to the office." is not such a statement.
